summary: Master the transition to ISO/IEC 27701 with our detailed guides. Ensure your organization meets global privacy standards efficiently.
audienceIntro: This PECB Certified ISO/IEC 27701 Transition course is essential for professionals committed to maintaining cutting-edge privacy management practices and ensuring their organization's PIMS remains compliant and effective. This course is designed for: Privacy Officers seeking to update their PIMS in line with ISO/IEC 27701:2025. Data Protection Officers (DPOs) responsible for PII compliance and governance. Information Security Managers overseeing privacy controls and data protection. Compliance Managers needing to interpret new ISO/IEC 27701:2025 requirements. PIMS Consultants advising clients on privacy framework transitions. IT Security Architects designing privacy-by-design solutions. Legal and Regulatory Affairs Specialists interpreting privacy standard changes. Risk Managers assessing PII-related risks and control effectiveness. Professionals involved in implementing or maintaining an ISO/IEC 27701 PIMS. Individuals aiming to validate their expertise in the latest ISO/IEC 27701 standard.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
